answer_1.quote: We demonstrate the stronger cache performance of HISTALIGN through the synthetic ambiguous template task and showcase its strength in improving coherence for open-ended prompt continuation and faithfulness for abstractive summarization and data-to-text.
answer_1.outputs: Generated continuations, abstractive summaries, data-to-text sentences

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the faithfulness of generated summaries by three widely-used automatic metrics: FactCC and DAE ... and Entity Precision... We also report ROUGE-L... Open-Ended Generation... we report n-gram diversity and MAUVE scores... coherence is approximated by the cosine similarity of the SimCSE sentence embeddings...

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation on Amazon MTurk to ask workers to compare the continuations generated by TRIME and HISTALIGN... We collect 3 annotations per example... We take the percentage of passages that are judged as coherent and/or fluent.
answer_4.guideline: Workers were asked to compare continuations and rate them on coherence and fluency (and for summarization, faithfulness and informativeness).
